notes: 1.66.8: PHF Task — OVERVIEW/REPORTING PERFORMANCE BLOCKER FIX (LOCAL ONLY; no commit/push/deploy, no schema/migration, no Supabase MAIN, no PROD; Company PostgreSQL only). Business rules / numbers / scope / permissions UNCHANGED — proven byte-identical below. (A) FAN-OUT: the Overview screen used to fire 3 separate reporting actions and the Báo cáo screen 5, each independently re-resolving + re-fetching the SAME authorized population (~3.6s each; parallel calls also congested the read-bridge past its 6s cap and 500'd). NEW action getTaskReportV2Bundle (api/_lib/task-reporting-v2.js; wired in api/data.js + server.js manifest+switch, api-parity 327/327) resolves resolveOverviewContext ONCE and computes every requested section from that single population. Each of the 5 standalone actions was split into getX(session,input)=buildXFromContext(await resolveOverviewContext(...)) so their external contract is unchanged and the bundle reuses the exact same buildXFromContext — every section object is byte-identical to the standalone result (verified ADMIN/TBP/NV × overview/trend/person/department/category = 15/15 IDENTICAL on real data). Frontend: openTaskOverviewV2 + reloadTaskOverviewV2Panels + the refresh/period-nav handlers now fire ONE bundle (sections overview/trend/department); openTaskReport + reloadTaskReportPanels fire ONE bundle (5 sections). Individual loadTaskOverviewV2*/loadTaskReport* kept ONLY for single-panel retry. OVERVIEW_CALLS 3->1, REPORTING_CALLS 5->1. Local before/after (same server): Overview ADMIN 4.5-5.0s -> 2.6-3.7s; Report ADMIN 5.1-7.6s (with intermittent 3/5 bridge-timeout failures) -> 3.6-4.1s (0 failures); TBP smaller but consistent. (B) LATERAL: the per-Task 'LEFT JOIN LATERAL (... ORDER BY assigned_at LIMIT 1)' that produced initial_primary_employee_code (one correlated execution per population row) is replaced by ONE non-correlated grouped derived table (DISTINCT ON (task_id) over the primary-assignee rows, hash-joined). Byte-identical semantics — earliest role='primary' assignee, inactive rows included, retained across transfers. proposal_generated kept as the inline EXISTS (single indexed probe via task_proposal_decisions_generated_task_uq). Query count per executor call UNCHANGED (main + completion + churn). INDEX_REQUIRED = NO — uses the existing task_assignees_task_idx. (C) MANAGED-SCOPE PROBE: was a separate listTasks(limit:1) request on every first Task screen. It is already memoized once per identity generation and already fired in parallel with the route load. Additionally, the Overview bundle now returns nav_signals {hasManagedPeople, canManageTaskPermissions} — computed by the NEW shared pure task-core.js::deriveTaskNavAuthoritySignals(actorContext,scope) that listTasks() ALSO now uses (single source of truth, zero drift), threaded local-only through the descriptor builder + bridge (never signed / never sent over the wire; executor strips it defensively). phfRenderTask SKIPS the eager probe for the dashboard/list/report routes (all now self-hydrate — list always did, Overview bundle now does) and fires it as a fallback AFTER applyTaskRoute only if managedScopeHydrated is still false (load errored) — so the gate can never hang and stays fail-closed. HYDRATION GATE + identity-switch stale-data protection UNCHANGED and still enforced (tests below). Notifications remain secondary (never block screen readiness). BACKEND CHANGED = YES (additive read-path only: new bundle action + section-builder extraction + LATERAL->grouped rewrite + nav_signals passthrough; no business rule, no schema, no migration, no write path, no permission/scope decision).
